scope: Current origin/development money-domain and explicitly assigned operational/contributor sources. Model links are partial contracts, not function-by-function semantic refinement. Function candidates are lexical search results.

sources.reason: Pure decimal-string to bounded base-unit parsing. No mutable lifecycle; transaction amount and asset identities remain governed by their payment models.
Static guide rows derived from the canonical Slopbot penalty table. This projection has no state transition; penalty application, reversal and funded-award preservation remain modeled elsewhere.
Pure structural and total/order validation of a supplied summary object; no publication or journal mutation. Points journal and source publication state remain separate models.
Pure presentation projection of supplied registry reward/bounty fields; no storage or asynchronous work. Project lifecycle and payment state are not established by this display helper.

Pure amount formatting and funded/unfunded labels from supplied fields; no stored state, I/O or transition. Input funding truth is owned by the allocation/registry flow, and formatting is not a proof of funding.

Pure reward-asset choice construction, schema validation and same-object comparison. No I/O or persistent state. Authoritative asset verification and activation remain registry/chain state transitions and are not exempted here.
Pure lookup of a supplied project's exact cycle cap override; no mutation or rollover state. Cap enforcement remains in monthly allocation and vault models.

Pure construction and preview of an unverified bounty proposal from form inputs. No submission, approval, funding or payment occurs in this module; those state transitions remain API and bounty model responsibilities.
Type declarations only for immutable wallet evidence; emitted JavaScript has no runtime state or transitions.
Pure address validation, equality, byte conversion and shortened display. No claim storage, consent or authorization mutation; actual wallet registration/binding remains modeled and is not exempted.

Pure deterministic Merkle leaf/tree/proof calculation over supplied amounts and addresses; no external state or root posting. This classification does not claim cryptographic correctness or replace the distributor state machine.
